articles.summary: TARRYTOWN, N.Y., April 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. (NYSE:PBH) today announced that it will issue its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter and year-end earnings release on Wednesday, May 13, 2026 after the market close. The following morning, May 14, at 8:30 a.m.
articles.title: Prestige Consumer Healthcare to Release Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Year-End Earnings Results
